text:
maria_support: Customer reports embeddings suddenly changed width after we enforced a variant lock this morning. They say their index ingestion started failing with an assertion: expected 1024, got 1536. Posting their minimal repro and API response below.

katie_cs: customer id cust-842. They pinned to model v2-optimized yesterday. Worked for weeks, then after the pin the embed size shifted during a high-throughput batch. They attached logs.

maria_support: repro snippet from customer:```bash
POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings
Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>
{
  "model": "rwinf/embed-compact@v2-optimized",
  "input": ["doc1", "doc2"]
}```

maria_support: API response they got:```json
{
  "data": [
    {"embedding": [/* 1536 floats */]},
    {"embedding": [/* 1536 floats */]}
  ],
  "model": "rwinf/embed-compact@v2-optimized"
}```

hao_eng: thanks — first things: did the customer get a variant fallback during throttling? If routing substituted a larger variant we might return a different vecsize.

sam_ml: @hao_eng also curious about batchpad/concat behavior. If their client expects padded-to-1024 but we returned 1536 maybe concatenation of sub-embeddings or a KV-cache mismatch.

maria_support: customer confirms no HTTP 429, all 200. They run a batching client (internal). They saw the swap only after we rolled a config that locked the variant.

katie_cs: they're blocked — search index ingestion fails with assertion and crashes importer. Asked for a temp mitigation.

hao_eng: immediate mitigation options: 1) Ask the customer to explicitly request a known model id with an immutable checksum (we can provide a commit hash) 2) Serve them from dedicated capacity pinned to exact binary 3) On our side revert the routing change that applied variant aliasing.

sam_ml: for triage I need: request ids, full response headers, and a single-base64 embedding sample so I can inspect dimension. Also the model metadata we returned (we attach model config heartbeat).

maria_support: adding the request_id: req_0a1b2c3d and response headers they included: ```
x-redwood-model: rwinf/embed-compact@v2-optimized
x-redwood-variant: embed-compact-x86-q8_1536
x-request-id: req_0a1b2c3d
```

hao_eng: aha header shows variant embed-compact-x86-q8_1536 — that's a different internal variant. It looks like during the lock we allowed aliasing to a quantized variant with output size 1536. Not supposed to happen for that alias.

maria_support: so the pinned alias mapped to a wrong variant under pressure?

hao_eng: likely an off-by-one in our variant selection heuristic when we build the alias map. Could be a config mismatch between model catalog and alias table after the recent rollout. I'm going to open an infra job to check alias->variant mapping snapshots around 2976543000-2976543300.

infra_bot: Created ticket INFRA-5924 for alias mapping audit. Linked logs and the request id provided.

sam_ml: I'll reproduce locally by calling the same model alias, simulating our routing with the alias snapshot. If I can reproduce the dimension flip, I'll propose auto-fixing alias table and a backfill to mark the correct variant.

katie_cs: customer asked for a short-term client-side workaround: can we offer a header that forces returning embeddings truncated or padded?

hao_eng: we don't currently provide truncation server-side. But we can add a compatibility option: X-compat-embed-len: 1024 for specific tenants — scope-limited hotfix. Need approvals from infra and security.

maria_support: customer accepted a temporary workaround: we'll proxy their requests through a small Redwood edge lambda that trims/pads to 1024 while we fix the root cause. Katie, can you coordinate acceptance and uplift?

katie_cs: yes, I'll share a template edge function and coord with their eng lead.

sam_ml: notes for postmortem: 1) validate alias snapshots are immutable when a variant lock is applied 2) add unit tests for alias->variant dimension sanity 3) add alert when returned embedding length mismatches model catalog value.

hao_eng: also add a brief migration plan for customers pinned to older aliases: run a catalog-consistency job across all tenant pins to detect any mismatches.

maria_support: I'll update the customer with status: edge proxy in progress, INFRA-5924 opened, eng-ml reproducing. Estimated ETA for root fix 48–72h.

katie_cs: customer replied: "Thanks — edge proxy works, pipeline green. Please keep me posted." :raised_hands:

maria_support: closing loop here. Will add notes to INFRA ticket and attach customer's logs. If anyone wants to join the postmortem loop, ping me.

hao_eng: copying this to eng-ml and eng-infra channels for visibility.

sam_ml: thanks team. We'll aim to have a validated fix and a follow-up postmortem in the next 3 business days.
